items.title: 3.6 Angular momentum ke baqa ka qanoon (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.6 with Figs. 3.18 to 3.23 (PDF 68-71).

blocks.title: Angular momentum ke baqa ka qanoon
blocks.text: Agar system par koi bahri torque na lage to system ka kul angular momentum mustaqil rehta hai: L_total = L1 + L2 + ... = mustaqil.

Angular momentum ke baqa ka qanoon physics ke bunyadi usoolon mein se hai; yeh kainati (cosmological) se sub-microscopic satah tak sabit hua hai. Us ka asar tab saaf nazar aata hai jab ek akela ghoomta jism apna moment of inertia badle: agar moment of inertia I1 ka jism angular speed omega1 se ghoomta hua apna moment of inertia I2 kar le to us ki angular speed omega2 bhi yun badalti hai ke us ka angular momentum mustaqil rahe, is liye I1 omega1 = I2 omega2. Angular momentum vector quantity hai jis ki simt gardish ke axis ke saath hai, to axis ke saath angular momentum ki simt bhi fixed rehti hai: kisi cheez ka gardish ka axis apna rukh nahi badlega jab tak koi bahri torque use na badle. Yeh haqeeqat Suraj ke gird chalti Zameen ke liye bohat aham hai: Zameen koi aur qabil-e-zikr torque mehsoos nahi karti, kyunke us par lagne wali bari force Suraj ki kheench hai, to hamare gird kainat ki nisbat Zameen ki gardish ka axis ek simt mein fixed rehta hai.
Angular momentum ke baqa ki misalein

items: Diving board se kudta aadmi: springboard se kudte diver ko pani ki satah chhoone se pehle hawa mein kuch qalabaziyan leni parti hain (Fig. 3.18). Springboard chhorne ke baad woh haath aur taangein samet kar jism gol karta hai; us ka moment of inertia ghatta hai aur woh hawa mein bari angular velocity se ghoomta hai. Pani ki satah chhoone ke qareeb woh haath aur taangein phaila deta hai, halki speed se pani mein dakhil hota hai aur hamwar dive karta hai.

Ghoomta ice skater (Fig. 3.19): ice skater baazu mor kar aur phaili taang doosri taang ke qareeb la kar apni angular velocity barha sakta hai; aisa kar ke woh apna moment of inertia ghatata hai, to angular speed barhti hai. Jab woh haath aur ek taang bahar phailata hai to moment of inertia barhta hai aur angular velocity ghatti hai: angular momentum = (moment of inertia)(angular velocity), L = I x omega.

Turntable par khara haathon mein wazan uthaye shakhs (Fig. 3.20): ek shakhs dono taraf phaile haathon mein bhari masses (dumb-bells) le kar turntable par khara hai; jaise woh haath andar kheenchta hai us ki angular speed foran barhti hai, kyunke haath andar kheenchne par moment of inertia ghatta hai, jo angular speed barhata hai.

Flywheel (Fig. 3.21): axle wale bhari pahiye par mushtamil mechanical device, jo gardishi energy mehfooz karne, output ke utaar charhao hamwar karne aur cycles aur doosri gariyon, sanati machinery, gyroscopes, bahri jahazon aur spacecraft jaise bohat se istemalat mein istehkam dene ko istemal hota hai. Jab flywheel ghoomta hai to us ka angular momentum us ke rukh ki tabdeeliyon ki muzahimat karta hai, istehkam qaim rakhte hue, jo un systems mein mufeed hai jinhen bahri mudakhlat ke baghair apne rukh par sahih qaboo chahiye. Balance wheel kehlane wala flywheel oscillation ki qaboo shuda raftar qaim rakh kar mechanical gharion aur watches ka waqt-rakhne ka nizam regulate karta hai (Do You Know).

Gyroscope (Figs. 3.22, 3.23): Zameen ke axis ki nisbat apna rukh qaim rakhne, ya apne rukh ki tabdeeliyon ki muzahimat ke liye istemal hone wala device. Yeh sahare ke chhallon mein pivoted lage flywheel par mushtamil hai aur apne bare moment of inertia ki wajah se angular momentum ke baqa ke qanoon par kaam karta hai. Bari angular speed se ghoomte hue yeh bara angular momentum pata hai, to us ke gardishi axis ka rukh badalna mushkil hai: rukh ki tabdeeli ko angular momentum ki tabdeeli chahiye, aur bare angular momentum ki simt badalne ko utna hi bara torque chahiye. Gyroscope jhuka ho tab bhi gire baghair utha rehta hai. Gyroscope ke bare istemalat hawai jahazon, aabdozon aur khalai gariyon ke rehnuma nizam mein hain, taake khala mein khaas simt qaim aur rasta seedha rahe.

blocks.alt: Diver board se seedha phaila hua nikalta hai (bara moment of inertia, aahista ghoomna), hawa mein gend ki tarah simat jata hai (chhota moment of inertia, tez ghoomna, naranji teer), phir pani mein jane se pehle dobara phail kar ghoomna kam karta hai. Dabbe mein: angular momentum L = I omega mustaqil rehta hai.
blocks.caption: Diving board se chhalang lagata aadmi (Figure 3.18 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Ghoomte skater ke do hisse, saamne se. Baazu bahar: chaura naranji ghoomne ka daira, bara moment of inertia aur aahista ghoomna. Baazu andar: chhote surkh daire, chhota moment of inertia aur tez ghoomna.
blocks.caption: Ice skater: I bara aur omega chhota, phir I chhota aur omega bara (Figure 3.19 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Turntable par khara shakhs dono haathon mein mass pakre hai. (a) mein baazu phaile hain aur turntable aahista ghoomta hai. (b) mein masses seene ke paas khench liye gaye hain aur turntable tez ghoomta hai.
blocks.caption: Turntable par masses pakre aadmi, baazu bahar (a) aur andar (b) (Figure 3.20 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Saamne se flywheel: bhari surmai kinara chhe teeliyon se axle par lage hub se juda, naranji teer ke mutabiq ghoomta. Labels batate hain ke bhari kinara zyada tar mass axle se door rakhta hai, jis se moment of inertia bara hota hai, aur dabbe mein rotational kinetic energy = (1/2) I omega^2.
blocks.caption: Flywheel (Figure 3.21 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Stand par gyroscope: bhari gehra rotor aik axle par ghoomta hai jo neeli andaruni gimbal ring mein laga hai; yeh ring stand par tiki naranji bahari gimbal ring ke andar ghoom sakti hai. Axle ke saath surkh teer spin axis aur angular momentum L = I omega dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Gimbal rings mein gyroscope (Figure 3.22 ke mutabiq asal 3D model; ghuma kar har taraf se dekhein).
blocks.long_description: Dono gimbal rings axle ko har simt mein azaad rakhti hain, stand us par zor nahi dalta; is liye jab rotor tez ghoomta hai to us ka angular momentum L = I omega axle ko usi simt mein rakhta hai, chahe stand ko jhukayein ya ghumayein.

fallback.text: Gyroscope: do gimbal rings mein tez ghoomta rotor apna spin axis (angular momentum L = I omega) usi simt mein rakhta hai.
fallback.alt: 3D model ki tasveer: Gimbal rings mein gyroscope.

blocks.caption: Side notes
rows: ruki cycle par baithein to girte hain, magar chalti cycle ke ghoomte pahiyon ka angular momentum kisi tabdeeli ki muzahimat karta hai aur cycle ko seedha aur mustehkam rakhne mein madad deta hai
ungli ke gird lipat-ti dori par gend dori chhoti hone par tez hoti hai

jab qutbi barf pighal kar dariyaon ki shakal mein beh jati hai to pani ka aur is liye Zameen ka apne axis ke gird moment of inertia barhta hai; angular momentum ke baqa se Zameen ki angular velocity ghatti hai, to din lamba hota hai
coasting ghoomta system (funnel) beaker mein pani tapakne par sust kyun hota hai?
sayyare elliptical madaron mein chalte hain jin ke ek focus par Suraj hai; Suraj ke qareeb sayyare ki madari velocity khud barh jati hai; kyun?

blocks.prompt: Diver board se I = 18 kg m^2 ke saath nikalta hai, simat kar 3.6 kg m^2 karta hai aur simte hue 1.0 s mein do chakkar leta hai. Agar woh na simat-ta to board se pani tak 1.5 s mein kitni revolutions karta (numerical problem 3.10)? Kawwa ghoomti plate se roti utha leta hai aur plate tez ho jati hai; kyun (constructed response 3.2)?
blocks.explanation: Simte hue omega2 = 2 rev s^-1; I1 omega1 = I2 omega2 se omega1 = 3.6 x 2 / 18 = 0.4 rev s^-1, to 1.5 s mein woh 0.4 x 1.5 = 0.6 rev karta. Roti hatane se ghoomte system ka moment of inertia ghatta hai; bahri torque na hone par L = I omega mustaqil hai, to angular velocity barhti hai.

items: Bahri torque nahi: L_total mustaqil, I1 omega1 = I2 omega2; axis apna rukh rakhta hai (Zameen ka axis fixed rehta hai).

Misalein: diver aur skater (haath paon andar, I kam, omega zyada), turntable par shakhs, flywheel (energy mehfooz, machinein hamwar, gharion mein balance wheel), gyroscope (bara L rukh badalne ki muzahimat; hawai jahaz, aabdoz, spacecraft ki rehnumai).
